in_sanskrit.name: अक्षिका
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The name Akshikaa is derived from the Sanskrit word 'aksh' meaning eye and 'ikaa' meaning goddess or sage. The name signifies one who has the divine knowledge or the goddess of knowledge. In Hindu mythology, the goddess Saraswati is often referred to as the goddess of knowledge and wisdom.

in_hindi.name: अक्षिका
in_hindi.long_meaning: The name Akshikaa in Hindi is translated as 'ज्ञानका' which means 'knowledge giver' or 'goddess of knowledge'. This name is derived from the Sanskrit word 'aksh' meaning eye and 'ikaa' meaning goddess.

in_tamil.name: அக்ஷிகா
in_tamil.long_meaning: The name Akshikaa in Tamil is 'அக்ஷிகா'. The meaning of the name is 'அரியர் இன்பம்' which means 'joy of the sage' and 'கல்வியார்' which means 'scholar'. This name is derived from the Sanskrit word 'aksh' meaning eye and 'ikaa' meaning goddess or sage.

in_telugu.name: అక్షికా
in_telugu.long_meaning: The name Akshikaa in Telugu is 'అక్షికా'. The meaning of the name is 'జ్ञానపొహు' which means 'giver of knowledge'. This name is derived from the Sanskrit word 'aksh' meaning eye and 'ikaa' meaning goddess or sage.

in_marathi.name: Akshikaa
in_marathi.long_meaning: Akshikaa हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Akshikaa is a Sanskrit name derived from the word 'akshara', which means 'letter' or 'symbol'.
